name: Early Rising
overview: Scripture reveals the divine ordering of day and night, established by God through the creation of the greater light to rule the day and the lesser light to rule the night, marking times and seasons (Genesis 1:14-16). This celestial design underscores the significance of early rising as part of the created rhythm for human life. The flood narrative (Genesis 7:17-19) emphasizes the earth's physical features, including high hills and mountains, which are part of the created world meant to be inhabited and divided by day and night, further highlighting the intentional structure God set for daily living and devotion.
